description: Draws a one-page map of where the user's wealth sits, from what the user says: every place grouped by country and by kind, how many institutions and countries a family would have to deal with, and what each institution sees. Takes names, kinds and countries only, never amounts or account numbers. Optional answers: owns_business (the user owns or co-owns a business), recent_liquidity (the user sold a business or property, or received a large sum, in the last two years) and who_knows (whether one person holds the full list today). The map restates the answers without judging them, and nothing is stored or added to the user's book.
